notes: Scan 012 bears the autograph page number 2 at top centre and a separate pencil foliation 11 at lower left. The page is upright and has no date. Its first line, reste couvrant., is a continuation fragment; no previous page was consulted.

A separate slanted marginal heading labels that generalization. The lower paragraph compares n=0 and n=1 and invokes composition of covering families in a two-arrow diagram. This describes the written argument without asserting its validity.

The full page and exactly two native-resolution halves were viewed. Their original boxes were [0,0,1685,1299] and [0,1062,1685,2361], with 237 pixels of overlap, approximately ten percent of page height. No OCR, outside research or TeX compilation was used.

At scan 012, middle finite-sequence line, the curved leader connects (non vide) to the gap after finie. It is not a parenthesis around the alpha sequence. The superscript after N is cancelled; its star reading remains doubtful because the hatch obscures the original strokes.

At scan 012, closing slice-category expression of the bracketed paragraph, the final multiplication separator before alpha_n is not written. The transcription retains that omission. This is a local notational observation, not a claim about the mathematical argument.
